name: load_macro_from_url

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL whose response body is one SQL [`CREATE MACRO`](https://duckdb.org/docs/sql/statements/create_macro) statement (scalar or table macro). Redirects are followed; any non-`200` response raises an error.

description:
Fetch the URL, check that the response body is a macro definition, create the macro, and return `Successfully loaded macro: <name>`. The macro is then callable by name like any other DuckDB macro.

The response body must be exactly one `CREATE MACRO` or `CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO` statement. Anything else raises an error and nothing runs, including a macro followed by another statement. `TEMP` macros are rejected. The check covers what runs when the file loads, not what the macro does when you call it, so the security model is **trust the URL**. See the Trust model section.
